name: crm-system
description: CRM 客户关系管理系统 — 前后端一体启动

scripts.install:all: cd crm-backend && npm install && cd ../crm-frontend && npm install
scripts.db:setup: cd crm-backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx src/seed.ts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
